item.title: Montpelier’s River Of Life Church Offers Community Meals
item.description: MINISTRY IN ACTION … Volunteers at River of Life Church in Montpelier help prepare food for its weekly Tuesday night meals at no cost. item.description: PHOTOS BY JOHN FRYMAN / THE VILLAGE REPORTER PAINTED JOURNEY … Bryan resident Eric Ryan has painted three outdoor murals outside of the Sanctuary of Williams County building.
